summary: Phase 3 Night Finder — Story viewer + Notifications on like/comment. Backend: 7/7 pytest PASS. Feed filter by user_id works (isolates to one user, respects blocklist). Like → creates ONE moment_like notification for the moment author with all expected fields (notification_id, user_id=owner, actor_id, actor_name, actor_picture, moment_id, created_at, read=false). Duplicate like on same moment does NOT create a new notification (idempotent upsert). Self-like/self-comment does NOT create a notification (verified in DB: 0 self-notifs). Comments → creates moment_comment notif with text_preview + actor_name. Frontend /story-viewer: renders correctly with black background, progress bars, header (avatar + name + club + timeAgo), close button, caption pill.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 3852 lines — recommend splitting into feature modules (moments.py, notifications.py, swipe.py, auth.py) for maintainability.
GET /api/notifications returns a raw list; other endpoints (moments/feed, moments/highlights, moment_comments) return {items, count}. Inconsistent shape — consider wrapping notifications too.

story-viewer.tsx uses hard-coded #000/#fff colors instead of theme tokens for the black background. Acceptable for Instagram-style fullscreen (Instagram's viewer is always dark) but flagging for consistency.
story-viewer paused state pill uses top:'48%' which may overlap the caption on very short screens (< 600px). Not a blocker.
seed_data_creation: No new seed created. Used existing 8 demo moments seeded in club_moments (Chloé, Louis, Camille etc.).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Notifications collection now stores moment_like and moment_comment entries with keys: notification_id, user_id (target=owner), actor_id, actor_name, actor_picture, moment_id, [text_preview for comments], created_at, read. GET /api/notifications returns a raw list (not wrapped). Feed endpoint accepts optional ?user_id= to filter to a single user (used by story viewer). Story-viewer route: /story-viewer?user_id=xxx&user_name=xxx with testIDs `story-viewer` and `story-close`.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all features working as specified.
